description: Event-trigger routines for Grok Bot (GitHub v1; Slack deferred). Provision via grokbot-setup-routines.py --triggers

triggers.name: GitHub PR opened
triggers.prompt:
GITHUB TRIGGER — new PR opened on n8n-cursor.
1. Use GitHub plugin — read PR title, author, changed files summary
2. Post 5-bullet summary in this chat for operator
3. If staging/agent/* branch → note CI auto-merge path; if main → L3 HITL only
4. python3 scripts/hive/grok-hive-tool.py --grok-agent "Forge" --tool scorpion_register_outcome
Read-only — never merge or deploy.

triggers.name: GitHub push staging
triggers.prompt:
GITHUB TRIGGER — push to staging on n8n-cursor.
1. Summarize commits in push (GitHub plugin)
2. Suggest smoke commands: smoke-ce-builder.sh, grokbot-verify-agents.sh
3. Register read-only outcome — no deploy
Disabled by default — enable after operator confirms GitHub trigger works in Grok UI.

operatorPromptTemplate: Set up a Grok routine: when {event} on repo {repository}, run agent {agent} with instructions: {summary}. Use Plugins → GitHub already connected.
